facts.fact: ECOWAS says Benin was among the first member states to deploy SIGMAT, which exchanges goods-in-transit data electronically between member states, and TradeMark Africa handed IT equipment to Benin customs on 5-6 November 2026 to reduce downtime on its national node.

systems.owner: ECOWAS / Benin Directorate General of Customs

CPV.note: Cabo Verde is named only as a task force member.

GMB.note: The Gambia is named only as the task force chair's country.
